::: {.why}
A referral changes the outcome more than any other single factor, and the only way to get one is a message specific enough that answering it is easy.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Write and send three outreach messages, each referencing something specific the recipient did.
- State what you are asking for, which is a conversation rather than a job.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Write three messages, each under 150 words: who you are in one sentence, the specific thing of theirs you read and one real question about it, what you have built this year in one clause, and a clear small ask. The question about their work is what makes it a message rather than a request.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Send them, and set up the follow-up discipline: a tracker with the date sent, the ask, and a follow-up date two weeks out. Then write the two-sentence follow-up now, while you are not disappointed, because writing it later is harder.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Draft the version for people you do not know at all, which is a different message: shorter, with a link to one write-up rather than an attachment, and a smaller ask.
:::
:::

## Deliverable

::: {.deliverable}
Three outreach messages sent, a tracker with follow-up dates, and a pre-written follow-up.
:::

## Checkpoint

::: {.checkpoint}
What are you actually asking for in an outreach message, and why is asking for a job the wrong ask?
:::

Ten minutes tonight so Day 355, Tuesday, 27 July 2027 starts clean. This is what the evening email sends you.

::: {.task-list .prep}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arrange a mock interview for tomorrow with a real person if you can, and a full self-run version if you cannot.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Send them three probability problems and one behavioural question in advance so they do not have to prepare.
:::
